package com.acme.common.validation;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/**
 * Postal code validation for the countries we ship to.
 */
public final class PostalCodeValidator {

    private static final Map<String, Pattern> PATTERNS = Map.of(
            "SG", Pattern.compile("\\d{6}"),
            "MY", Pattern.compile("\\d{5}"),
            "GB", Pattern.compile("[A-Z]{1,2}\\d[A-Z\\d]? ?\\d[A-Z]{2}"));

    private PostalCodeValidator() {
    }

    public static boolean isValid(final String country, final String postalCode) {
        if (country == null || postalCode == null) {
            return false;
        }
        final Pattern pattern = PATTERNS.get(country.toUpperCase());
        return pattern != null && pattern.matcher(postalCode.trim()).matches();
    }

    public static boolean isSupported(final String country) {
        return country != null && PATTERNS.containsKey(country.toUpperCase());
    }
}
